name: pops
description: A full-screen app that displays multiple **decks** of **cards**. Each deck is a stack of four colored cards: the first (leftmost) card is **yellow**, the second is **red**, then **green**, then **blue**. Cards can be fanned, reordered, and expanded. Built with `index.html` and `index.css` (the main page and its styles; shared script in `shared.js`).
